title: WildWolf AntiCheat

注：若你不懂中文，建议学习中文后再使用此插件，当然，插件的config.yml和hint.yml的设置提示为中文，其余部分全部为中文 hint.yml里留的是插件团队的联系方式，实际使用时可以换成自己的联系方式
🛡️ WildWolf Watchdog & Velocity Sync WildWolf 是一款专为 PaperMC 与 Velocity Proxy 设计的高性能反作弊与全服同步封禁系统。它不仅拥有极低的系统占用，更具备精美的自定义封禁 UI，让你的服务器管理如同 ILS 盲降般精准、稳定。
🌟 核心特性 (Features) ⚡ 极致同步 (Proxy Sync) 配合 MySQL 数据库，实现 Paper 子服与 Velocity 代理端的无缝联动。玩家被封禁后，在代理端即可被拦截，无需进入子服。
🎨 电影级封禁排版 (Custom UI) 支持在 hint.yml 中完全自定义封禁界面。我们区分了 永久封禁 与 临时封禁 两种视觉模板，支持富文本颜色与多行排版。
🛰️ 智能检测 (Smart Checks) 针对生存服环境优化的移动检测逻辑：
Flight & Speed: 严密的位移算法。
GSIT 兼容: 完美处理玩家“坐”在 NPC 或其他实体头上的情况，杜绝误报。
📉 低熵开发 (Lightweight) 代码经过精简重构，拒绝冗余。即使在百人同服的情况下，依然保持极低的 Tick 占用。
🛠️ 安装指南 (Setup) 将 WildWolf.jar 放入 Paper 服务器的 plugins 文件夹。
将 WildWolfVelocity.jar 放入 Velocity 代理服务器的 plugins 文件夹。
配置数据库：在两端的配置文件中填入相同的 MySQL 连接信息。
自定义排版：编辑 Velocity 端的 hint.yml，打造属于你服务器的专属封禁通知。
📺 开发者寄语 (Dev Note) 作为一个爱画 Alan Becker 风火柴人动画的作者，我希望这个插件能像火柴人世界里的物理引擎一样精准；作为一个飞友，我保证它的每一次拦截都像 B737 的着陆一样干脆利落。
"公平游戏，安全护航。" —— WildWolf 团队

ENGLISH：

Note: If you do not understand Chinese, we recommend learning Chinese before using this plugin. Of course, the configuration hints in the plugin’s `config.yml` and `hint.yml` files are in Chinese, while the rest of the files are entirely in Chinese. The contact information listed in `hint.yml` belongs to the plugin team; you can replace it with your own contact information when using the plugin.
🛡️ WildWolf Watchdog & Velocity Sync WildWolf is a high-performance anti-cheat and server-wide ban synchronization system designed specifically for PaperMC and Velocity Proxy. It not only has extremely low system resource usage but also features a beautifully designed custom ban UI, making your server management as precise and stable as an ILS approach.
🌟 Core Features ⚡ Ultimate Synchronization (Proxy Sync) Works with a MySQL database to achieve seamless integration between Paper sub-servers and the Velocity proxy. Once a player is banned, they are immediately blocked at the proxy level without needing to enter the sub-server.
🎨 Cinematic-Quality Ban Layouts (Custom UI) Fully customize the ban interface via hint.yml. We provide distinct visual templates for Permanent Bans and Temporary Bans, supporting rich text colors and multi-line formatting.
🛰️ Smart Checks Movement detection logic optimized for survival server environments:
Flight & Speed: Rigorous displacement algorithms.
GSIT Compatibility: Perfectly handles situations where players are “sitting” on top of NPCs or other entities, eliminating false positives.
📉 Lightweight Development: Code has been streamlined and refactored to eliminate redundancy. Even with 100 players on the same server, it maintains extremely low tick overhead.
🛠️ Installation Guide (Setup): Place WildWolf.jar in the plugins folder of the Paper server.
Place WildWolfVelocity.jar in the plugins folder of the Velocity proxy server.
Configure the database: Enter the same MySQL connection information in the configuration files on both ends.
Customize formatting: Edit hint.yml on the Velocity side to create custom ban notifications for your server.
📺 Developer's Note As an author who loves drawing Alan Becker-style stick figure animations, I hope this plugin is as precise as the physics engine in the world of stick figures; as an aviation enthusiast, I guarantee that every interception will be as crisp and clean as a B737 landing.
